Playing Strategies

This card is perfect for defending, with 4 attack and 5 defense it can easily survive enemy attacks. Also it doesn't have any costs, but you can better use Dominator: The Professor's Top Terrorizer because it has 6 attack and 5 defense and also no costs.

Trivia
